items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: Like you'd be with Jack Kerr and then play with? ... if Jack wouldn't have a job then somebody hired I'd go play with them.

ctx.x: Well did you play with two bands at once, have them? Like you'd be with Jack Kerr and then play with?
No. Somebody else at the same time? Oh well if Jack wouldn't have a job then somebody hired I'd go play with them.
And the same with Duck, huh? Yeah. Who were some of the other bands that you used to be with?
